title: The company assistant, handing work over
starter: Show me the company assistant handing work over
intro: This is the company assistant. It answers from the company's approved pages and shows which one it used. When a task belongs to a colleague, it hands it to that colleague's personal agent and you see the receipt.
disclaimer: A working re-creation. Casa Aurora (made up) and everything about it are made up.
role: The company's orchestrator. Answers from approved company pages, and hands a colleague's work to that colleague's own agent.

pages.title: Delivery times
pages.body: Stock items arrive in 3 to 5 working days in mainland Portugal. Made-to-order pieces take 4 to 6 weeks. Deliveries to the islands take 5 working days more.

pages.title: Customer returns
pages.body: A customer can return a stock item within 30 days if it is unused and in its original packaging. Made-to-order pieces cannot be returned. Refunds are paid within 5 working days of the item arriving back.

pages.title: Holiday requests
pages.body: Ask for holiday at least two weeks ahead in the team calendar. Your team lead approves it. No more than two people from one team can be off at the same time.

pages.title: Expenses
pages.body: Hand in receipts within the month. Anything over 100 euros needs your team lead's approval before you spend it.
